description: This file defines the AmqpValidator class, which extends an abstract protocol validator to validate AMQP connection configurations including source, target, and URI schemes within an Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging context.

classes.name: AmqpValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates AMQP protocol connection specifications, including scheme validation, source, target, and payload mapping validation within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of AmqpValidator.

methods.name: validateSource
methods.description: Validates the source configuration, including enforcement rules and header mappings.

methods.name: validateTarget
methods.description: Validates the target configuration, including header mappings and address templates.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the specific connection type this validator is responsible for, which is AMQP 1.0.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs comprehensive validation of the Connection object, including URI scheme validation, source and target configs, and payload mappings.
